column1: # Mutation targets for the Go table leg.
# Columns: file, the test command that kills its mutants, timeout seconds.
# The command is the package test suite, never a narrower filter: the
# generated-unit tests (runGenerated) are what exercise the emitters.
# make mutation-go RUNS this command as the target oracle before measuring,
# with GOMEMLIMIT=6GiB and -p 1 -parallel 2 so a mutant never forks a crowd.
# Columns are tab-separated; report.go and the make target both read tabs.
